answer: Copying becomes a race the hostile operator always loses, and producing 62 original texts is the only way to fill 28 aliases; the fable log preserves both halves. The reveal must open the same ember hash, and a reveal that arrives late or mismatched is dropped at the crystal gate. Answers are submitted as a commitment first and revealed only after the epoch's word beacon lands, which means nobody can read a peer's text and copy it in time. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
